metadata.description: Block direct git/jj push and route through repo task runner (pkf run push / just push)

plugins.name: push-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse(Bash) hook that blocks `git push` / `jj git push` so Claude must go through repo-defined `pkf run push` (or `just push`) — keeps check/test/version-bump/translation gates from being bypassed.
